baseline.summary: Daytona sandboxes are isolated environments with their own kernel, filesystem and network stack, offered as container, Linux VM, Windows, macOS and GPU sandbox classes. Billing is per second for the vCPU, RAM and disk reserved while a sandbox is started; stopped or paused sandboxes are billed for disk only, and archived sandboxes are not billed. SDKs cover Python, TypeScript, Ruby, Go and Java.
